method.score: Weighted checklist score based on available positive daily/weekly/monthly trend checks.
method.ranking_score: Provisional technical rank = 55% risk-adjusted checklist score + 45% cross-sectional relative momentum score. The relative score uses percentiles: 30% 6-period monthly return, 25% 13-period weekly return, 25% 60-period daily return, 10% 20-period daily return and 10% latest volume / 20-session average; missing measures are excluded and available weights are renormalized.
method.sort_order: Technical rank score descending; then risk-adjusted checklist, relative momentum and longer-period momentum.
method.risk_adjustment: Experimental heat penalty subtracted from technical score; ranked by adjusted score
method.eligibility: At least 200 daily, 26 weekly and 12 monthly candles, with latest daily data no more than 10 days old

warning: Technical screening only, not a buy/sell recommendation. The composite technical rank is provisional and has not been validated by walk-forward or out-of-sample backtesting. Fundamental health, earnings quality, project ROI and cash-flow quality are not included. Full TSE/IFB coverage has not been independently verified.
